title: bin takes its spawn flags from windowless_spawn, so none of its subprocess calls opens a console window
intention: Every subprocess spawn in bin (cairn.py) takes its keywords from cairn.tools.windowless_spawn, so none opens a visible console window on Windows.
why: Akien 2026-11-20: popups while he works on the same box are annoying and sometimes interrupt his typing. Measured 2026-11-20 on akiendell: 1 non-proof file(s) in bin (cairn.py) call subprocess with neither detached_kwargs nor windowless_kwargs, and the scan that guards the helper looks only for Popen. This is bin's share of the sweep under 364704f371dd.
traces_to: CP4 (the system serves the person at the box); Law 4 (the widened scan enforces it); Rule 1 (the build lives inside its own component).
how: In each named file, pass windowless_kwargs() (the caller waits) or detached_kwargs() (the child outlives it) to every subprocess call, importing from cairn.tools.windowless_spawn.windowless_spawn; a call that must show a terminal keeps none and carries a marker comment. Red-first proof bin/proofs/test_bin_takes_its_spawn_flags_from_the_helper.py asserts unhelped_sites over bin names nothing.

clauses.claim: unhelped_sites over bin names no file, and every subprocess spawn in bin/cairn.py passes **windowless_kwargs(given=...) (given required: a bare **windowless_kwargs() loses inherited stdio on Windows) or **detached_kwargs(), or carries a '# visible-console:' marker
the component's behaviour is unchanged: its existing proofs read as they did before the edit

a real child's output reaches the caller: a parent with an inherited stdout pipe and no console runs a printing child through bin/cairn.py's _run, and the print arrives in the parent's captured stdout
